ayahs.en: When the victory of Allah has come and the conquest
ayahs.e2: When Allah’s ˹ultimate˺ help comes and the victory ˹over Mecca is achieved˺

ayahs.ar: وَرَأَيۡتَ ٱلنَّاسَ يَدۡخُلُونَ فِي دِينِ ٱللَّهِ أَفۡوَاجࣰا
ayahs.en: And you see the people entering into the religion of Allah in multitudes
ayahs.e2: and you ˹O Prophet˺ see the people embracing Allah’s Way in crowds
ayahs.tr: Wa ra-aitan naasa yadkhuloona fee deenil laahi afwajah

ayahs.ar: فَسَبِّحۡ بِحَمۡدِ رَبِّكَ وَٱسۡتَغۡفِرۡهُۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ تَوَّابَۢا
ayahs.en: Then exalt [Him] with praise of your Lord and ask forgiveness of Him. Indeed, He is ever Accepting of repentance
ayahs.e2: then glorify the praises of your Lord and seek His forgiveness, for certainly He is ever Accepting of Repentance
ayahs.tr: Fa sab bih bihamdi rabbika was taghfir, innahu kaana tawwaaba
